dedupe_keys.name: simulation outputs and result data for boosters or building renovations an evaluation of 4th generation district heating strategies

description: The deposit contains building-level demand outputs, domestic-hot-water profiles, scenario tables, sensitivity results and optimisation caches for a comparison of renovation and booster-heat-pump strategies in district heating. The provider is Casamassima, Luca; Kranzl, Lukas. Coverage: The description includes hourly building outputs and a grid-temperature sensitivity range of 25 to 70 degrees Celsius. Geographic extent and observation years are not established. Access: The depositor publishes the record and its file listing on Zenodo. Only metadata was read; the files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence and public access. Any separately cited input data retain their own terms. Limitations: The depositor warns that later deterministic-seeding changes reproduce the method but not the exact numerical baseline. This version dependence must be preserved. For simulation it supports comparison with the study results and regeneration of its reported scenarios. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network modelling. This thematic link does not establish use by the authors.
